notes.scope: Named Sticker items from the current Adopt Me Wiki sticker category. The category hub, Sticker Packs, Profile UI, and player trade values are excluded.
notes.availabilityPolicy: Unavailable uses the item's explicit wiki category; all other current category items are labeled available.
notes.tradeabilityPolicy: No is used for explicit Non-Tradable category items. Other items follow the official rule that purchased packs and individual stickers are tradeable.
notes.imagePolicy: Use exact wiki item thumbnails where present and keep documented placeholders for missing row art.
